title: CS2023 defines software-engineering quality and delivery competencies
locator: Software Engineering (SE), Preamble and Knowledge Units
paraphrase: CS2023 organizes requirements, design, construction, verification and validation, software quality, evolution, teamwork, and delivery as connected software-engineering competencies.
scope: Curriculum evidence for Volume 01 clean-code, refactoring, requirements, design, validation, review, and delivery concepts; detailed professional processes require their governing standards.
